_comment: Per-file freeze versions for the NEXT staging-bucket upload: each entry names the
version a file WILL carry when this pipeline writes it.
This map is hand-maintained and authoritative. It is NOT a generated mirror of the
staging bucket: the entries were seeded once from a listing of seeded_from_bucket and
are edited by hand from there on, so they can and should differ from what that bucket
holds today. Do not regenerate this file from a bucket listing -- that would discard
every deliberate bump and every why_bumped note.
The collection is deliberately NOT uniformly versioned. A file's version is the last
collection release in which its CONTENT changed: a file regenerated without a content
change keeps its existing version, and only a file whose content actually changes is
bumped to NEW_VERSION (config/pipeline.env). That is why no single NEW_VERSION can
name every file, and why versions are looked up here instead of hardcoded at call
sites. To ship a changed file at a new version, bump its entry here -- this map is the
only place a version is decided.
SHAPE. files is a tree keyed the way the freeze filename is built:
files[tissue_code][ome][data_category][data_details] -> entry
which is the same nesting load_qc()/load_differential_analysis() return, one level
deeper. The filename is the path: stem_prefix, then the four keys joined by '_', then
_v<version> and .<ext> -- exactly what write_with_path_name() composes. A file whose
name stops at data_category (the prot qc-report HTMLs) is keyed under the reserved
data_details '_none'; no real data_details starts with '_', so the two never collide.
ENTRY. version is the release the file ships at. ext is its extension without the dot.
why_bumped is a HAND-WRITTEN note saying what content change earned the current
version -- one line, empty when nobody has written one. Nothing reads it: it is there
so a bump carries its reason next to it instead of only in a commit message. Fill it
in the same edit that changes version.
tissue REPEATS the tissue_code the entry is nested under. It is redundant by
construction and nothing reads it -- the tree path is still the authority, and a
resources/ entry has none. It is written into every entry so a line deep in the file
says which tissue it belongs to without scrolling back to the enclosing key. Because
it is a copy, it can drift: when moving an entry between tissues, change both.
resources holds the files under the bucket's resources/ tier, whose names follow no
tissue/ome convention and so have no place in the tree. Keys are the version-stripped
basename without its extension.
unversioned_files is empty and stays empty: every file in the collection carries a
_v<version> token as of v2.0. It is kept as the place to declare an exception if one
is ever granted again.
version_counts tallies files + resources below as a self-check on edits; it is not a
census of the bucket.
cross_check: gsutil ls 'gs://pre-cawg/staging_20260720/**' | grep -v '/$'   then DIFF the _v<ver> suffixes against this map. Entries that differ are either a pending bump (expected) or a stale entry (fix by hand); never overwrite this file with the listing.
